summary: Frontend verification of new 'Financial Summary' section on /center-management (Phase 73 Center Reports). Logged in as Super Admin, navigated to Center Management, selected company fab4a7b8-3316-4eb2-b3cf-963cfab948c1 via the shadcn Select using data-testid=company-opt-<id>. Section renders with all expected testids; totals match spec (Investment ₹0, Income ₹0, Expense ₹6,000, Profit/Loss -₹6,000 in red rose-700); per-center row (BJQNBR-2KHR / IT39-9870a6-13b6) rendered correctly under [data-testid=reports-table-body]; Include pending entries checkbox toggles the section header between '(APPROVED)' and '(APPROVED + PENDING)' and triggers a refetch (numbers stayed the same as no pending entries exist for this company, which is expected). Regression checks: Add Center button and Manage Access panel still present and unaffected. Backend 403 cross-company guard not re-verified per main agent's note that it was already curl-verified.
critical_code_review_comments: CenterManagement.jsx is growing large (>400 lines mixing centers CRUD, access management and new reports section). Consider extracting the Financial Summary into its own component (CenterReportsSection.jsx) for maintainability.
loadReports() has no debounce; toggling include-pending in quick succession will fire back-to-back requests. A small guard/cancel-token would be cleaner but is not critical.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 73 Center Reports frontend passes. To verify company selector in Playwright, use page.click('[data-testid=center-company-select]', force=True) then locator('[data-testid=company-opt-<id>]').scroll_into_view_if_needed() + click(force=True) — the Company selector is a shadcn Select (not native <select>). Section header is CSS-uppercased so case-sensitive substring checks may miss; use case-insensitive checks or rely on data-testid values.
